newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel Eurbond underwriters to visit next week.
newsitem.headline: Israel Eurbond underwriters to visit next week.

text.p: Representatives from the seven investment banks chosen to underwrite Israel's Eurobond offerings will arrive in Israel next week, accountant general Shai Talmon said.
The underwriters and Finance Minister Dan Meridor will sign on September 10 the framework agreement for Israel's raising of capital on the European market, Talmon said.
Israel plans to raise $750 million over three years in Europe, including $200 million in a debut bond before the end of this year.
Deputy accountant general Avi Elkind said the framework plan will enable Israel to raise various sums of money in different currencies in accordance with its needs and market developments.

Merrill Lynch International is acting as lead underwriter. The other underwriters are Deutsche Morgan Grenfell of Germany, Union Bank of Switzerland, SBC Warburg, U.S. investment banks Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley and Daiwa Europe Ltd.
